description: This file contains a utility class 'CombinatoricsUtils' providing methods for combinatorial calculations such as binomial coefficients, factorials, Stirling numbers, and combinations generators, used within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: CombinatoricsUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for combinatorial calculations like factorials, binomial coefficients, Stirling numbers, and iteration over combinations.

methods.name: binomialCoefficient
methods.description: Computes the exact binomial coefficient 'n choose k' for given n and k, with size restrictions to fit into a long integer.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientDouble
methods.description: Computes an approximate binomial coefficient as a double, suitable for larger n where exact value might overflow.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientLog
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the binomial coefficient 'n choose k'.

methods.name: factorial
methods.description: Returns n! as a long, with size checks for overflow.

methods.name: factorialDouble
methods.description: Returns n! as a double, for larger n, with a maximum of 170.

methods.name: factorialLog
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of n!.

methods.name: stirlingS2
methods.description: Calculates the Stirling number of the second kind, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: combinationsIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over all k-element subsets of {0, ..., n-1}.

methods.name: checkBinomial
methods.description: Validates preconditions for binomial coefficient calculations.
